factorization: for the fixed equal-width partition, per-sector Tx constraints depend on its own steering candidate, so exhaustive per-sector feasibility is exhaustive within this finite design family
threshold_reuse: reuse every candidate constraint score, then search all candidates under each threshold, not just one coverage-best angle
normalization_caveat: search peak sampled locally at 0.01deg around steering; final uses full dense FOV maximum; final feasibility is reported separately, not assumed
continuous_minimum: not proven; finer steering candidates or nonuniform boundaries not covered
